classification.difficultyReason: Multiply by the squared denominator, factor a quartic, interpret its graph and exclude the undefined value.

answer.worked:
The restriction is $x\ne 0$. Multiplying both sides by $x^2$, which is positive on this domain:
$$\begin{aligned}
x^2+2x^3-x^4&\ge 2x\\
-x^4+2x^3+x^2-2x&\ge 0\\
x^4-2x^3-x^2+2x&\le 0\\
x^3(x-2)-x(x-2)&\le 0\\
(x-2)(x^3-x)&\le 0\\
x(x-2)(x^2-1)&\le 0\\
x(x-2)(x-1)(x+1)&\le 0.
\end{aligned}$$
The polynomial has simple zeros $-1,0,1,2$ and a positive leading coefficient. Its graph is on or below the axis for $-1\le x\le 0$ and $1\le x\le 2$.

Excluding $x=0$ gives
$$-1\le x<0\quad\text{or}\quad 1\le x\le 2.$$

spec.mathematics: y=x(x-2)(x-1)(x+1); non-positive on [-1,0] and [1,2]; the original rational inequality excludes x=0.
